content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Lifetimes describe how long references remain valid and how their validity is related. An annotation communicates a relationship to the compiler; it does not extend the lifetime of a value.

content_blocks.title: A reliable way to reason about it
content_blocks.text: For Higher-Ranked Trait Bounds, write down the inputs, the guarantee you expect, and the boundary where that guarantee stops. Work through a minimal example first; then deliberately test one edge case. A lifetime annotation expresses a relationship between references. It cannot make a local value live longer and is not a runtime timer.
